regions.region: upper-right Scheme 1 generic allene addition diagram
regions.finding: General regio-/stereoselectivity schematic with generic R, Z1 and Z2 groups; it is not a reported experiment and no experiment record was created.

One reported preparation of Z-3a was extracted with reagent masses/amounts, solvent volumes, 30 min addition, N2, 25 °C for 9 h, workup, chromatography, product form and melting range; the paragraph gives no product yield and states no water addition.

regions.region: bottom Table 1 reaction drawing, rows 1-7 and footnotes a-c
regions.finding: Seven independent optimization entries were extracted. Product-specific yields and Z/E ratios were kept separate for 2a and 3a; explicit 0% outcomes were retained. Footnote-a LiOAc·2H2O (2 equiv) was added as a participant in entry 1, footnote-b A was resolved as n-hexane, and footnote-c NMR basis was attached to Z/E ratios.
The article says ESI experimental information is available, but no SI file was supplied or explicitly associated in this workspace; no SI facts were imported.

unresolved: The typical procedure reports no yield and does not state a water addition or water quantity; values were not borrowed from table rows with different reaction times.
The yield measurement basis is unstated for Table 1 entries other than the prose-supported isolated 28% yield of 2a in entry 1.
Candidate SMILES for drawn 1a/2a/3a do not encode alkene stereochemistry and remain structure-unverified.

regions.region: upper-left Table 2 generic reaction arrow, rows 1-9 and footnote a
regions.finding: Nine independent substrate-scope entries were extracted with R/R' assignments, water equivalents including explicit no-water rows, time, yield and lower-bounded Z/E ratios. Shared arrow conditions R'CN/n-hexane (1:1), I2 (2 equiv), N2 and 25 °C were applied only to these rows; footnote-a NMR basis was attached to selectivity.

regions.region: middle-left Scheme 2 upper and lower arrows
regions.finding: Two independent downstream experiments were extracted: DIBAL reduction of Z-3a to Z-8a (5 equiv, toluene, N2, 90 °C, 12.5 h, 79%) and NaH cyclization to oxazole 9a (1.2 equiv, THF, rt, 5 h, 96%).
Proposed mechanism through intermediates Z-4a and Z-5a leading to Z-2a/Z-3a; classified as mechanism, not as independent reported experiments, and no experiment records were created for its arrows.
